examples: Move all your settings to a new computer: export on the old one, import on the new one, and check the preview before you apply.
Restore your setup after a reinstall from a file you saved earlier.
how_to: Open settings, advanced, and press export config: a json file downloads.
On the other install press import config, choose the file, read the list of what would change, pick merge or replace, then press apply import.
The file never holds a password, token, api key or webhook, and an import never replaces one this install already has.
media_exempt: the visible parts are a file download and a one-time import preview; screenshots are recaptured with the rest before the next version bump
name: Export and import config
summary: save your whole configuration to one file and load it on another computer, or restore it later, with a preview of every change before anything is written.
where: Settings, advanced, export and import config.
